name: Lamorlette and Foster Fire Model
definition: A mixed framework for macro-movement of fire in production systems, specifically designed for the motion picture 'Shrek' by DreamWorks. It models fire using parametric space curves and particles to achieve a holistic look with artistic control.
summary: The Lamorlette and Foster Fire Model simulates fire holistically by evolving parametric space curves, distinguishing itself from atomistic particle systems.
